Metadata.siteDescription: From the street to your door. Food delivery in Douala.

LaunchPromo.headline: Free delivery on your first order

Splash.subtitle: From the street to your door. Order your favorite dishes from vendors around you — delivered home in 30 minutes.
Splash.roleRiderSub: Bike, bicycle or on foot — earn in your area.
Splash.trustDeliverySub: Bike, bicycle or on foot — in your area
Splash.zonesBody: We're starting in these two areas during the pilot phase. Gradual expansion to Bonapriso, Akwa, Bonanjo, Logbessou and more — sign up to be notified when your area opens.

FAQ.a1: You pick a vendor near you, order in 3 taps, pay with MoMo. A rider picks up your order and brings it to you in 30 minutes (bike, bicycle or on foot depending on distance).
FAQ.q2: Which areas do you deliver to?
FAQ.a2: During the pilot phase, we deliver in Bonamoussadi and Makepe in Douala. We're gradually expanding to other Douala neighborhoods.
FAQ.a3: Only by MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money. Payment is processed by Campay (an aggregator regulated by ANTIC + ART). No bank card required, no cash payment for now.
FAQ.a4: Delivery fees depend on the distance between you and the vendor. The exact amount appears at checkout before you confirm — no surprises.
FAQ.q5: What happens if the restaurant refuses my order?
FAQ.a5: If the restaurant doesn't confirm within 60 seconds of your payment, the order is cancelled automatically and the full amount is refunded to your MoMo account within 24 hours.
FAQ.q6: How do I become a vendor or rider?
FAQ.a6: Vendor: submit your application at /vendre (validated within 24h, commission only when we deliver an order for you). Rider: /livrer (weekly payout every Saturday 10pm via MoMo, validated within 4h, no deposit).
